item.title: THIS SATURDAY NIGHT | Domocile 'To The Moon' Album Release Party — Tue Sep 22 — One World Brewing – West
item.description:
September 26th at 9:00 PM ET | $10.00 tickets, $12.00 at the door
Domocile (DOMO) is a 4-piece electronic-infused instrumental jam band formed in Wilmington, NC in 2023 (Chase Farnitano – Guitar/Ableton, Wolf Lampke – Synth, Brandon Bales – Bass, Will Walter – Drums). Inspired by acts such as STS9, The New Deal, and Papadosio, DOMO combines dark, funky guitar riffs, space-driven synth and EDM-inspired vocal samples with a dynamic rhythm section to create a unique soundscape that is equal parts dancy and atmospheric. ​DOMO relies heavily on live improv and takes pride in ensuring each set is its own uniquely curated performance. This attention to detail has garnered them a local reputation as a can’t-miss live show and landed them opening slots with premier jamtronica acts such as Papadosio and Dizgo. ​

item.title: THIS THURSDAY | Gregory McLoughlin & The Lemonade Band — Tue Sep 22 — One World Brewing Downtown
item.description: Thursday, September 24th | 8:00 – 11:00 PM | No Cover Gregory McLoughlin is a songwriter and bass player living in Jersey City, New Jersey. He writes and records danceable tales of history, heartbreak, and redemption as a solo artist, but also writes for other artists. “Known for turning chance encounters into intimate musical conversations, Gregory McLoughlin has spent years refining his craft on sidewalks, festival campsites, and parking lots, armed with little more than a bass, a kick drum, and a foot tambourine. Now, with his debut album, Gregory McLoughlin, the New Jersey singer-songwriter steps fully into the spotlight, transforming a lifetime of sideman experience into a record that is as human as it is heartfelt. The album isn’t just a collection of songs; it’s a masterclass in storytelling and soul. item.title: Upcoming Events — Tue Sep 22 — French Broad River Brewery
item.description:
French Broad River Brewery is more than just a place to enjoy a drink—it’s a community hub where great beer, delicious pizza, live music, and good times come together. Just minutes from the Biltmore Estate & Downtown, our taproom is a gathering spot for locals and visitors alike. We regularly host live music and entertainment in our taproom, making French Broad River Brewery a lively hub of local activity. From bluegrass to reggae, there’s always something happening. Check out our Events Page to see what’s coming up next! No brewery experience is complete without great food. That’s why we offer French Broad River Pizza, serving up hot, hand-tossed pizzas made to order. Whether you’re here for a quick slice or a full meal, our pizza perfectly complements our craft beers and the lively atmosphere of our taproom. frenchbroadbrewery.com/pizza

item.title: Heart Break Ridge Trail FITNESS Hike, 8mi & 2,200ft (or, 11mi, 3,200ft) — Wed Sep 23, 9:30 AM
item.description:
The Asheville Hiking Group It looks like the weather forecast is now showing only a slight chance of rain for Wed. am, so I'm posting one of our favorites...
If you sign up and change your mind, change your RSVP to "not attending" to free up your reservation.
Please let the hike leader know if you choose to drive straight to the trailhead (9:30am) or carpool (8:45am). CARPOOLERS meet in the East Asheville Ingles parking lot up above the car wash and across the road from the VA on US highway 70/Tunnel Road at 8:45am,
Should be beautiful, with the leaves starting to change.

item.title: Scenic AVL #3: Kennilworth — Thu Sep 24, 5:45 PM
item.description:
The Asheville Hiking Group This route includes the Kenilworth neighborhood and the historically diverse South Asheville neighborhood. We will stop at a historic church and cemetery, as well as Kenilworth Park and Chiles House. We will go up Reservoir Rd to take in the view and get a workout.
**Rating: Moderate+** **Distance:** 5 miles **Elevation:** 670 feet **Surface:** Road **Type:** Butterfly Loop **Pace:** 3 mph on the flats, slower up Reservoir Rd **Gear:** In winter, please bring a headlamp or flashlight. water, snack, poles for the climb **Features:** Neighborhood charm Kenilworth, a little history, and views from the top. Not likely to see bears - but we did see one near this route earlier in the spring. **Dogs:** On leash. **Cautions:** Maintain normal traffic awareness. **Route:** [Kenilworth to Reservoir Rd ](https://www.alltrails.com/explore/map/kenilworth-to-reservoir-road-overlook-d9e74f4?p=-1&sh=ifwm3x).

item.title: NC Arboretum Walk: Gardens, Trails, a Stream, & a Plant Sale — Sat Sep 26, 8:30 AM
item.description:
Haywood County Walking Meetup Group We will be joining the Asheville Amblers, AARP, and perhaps some others for this walk. The walk is free, although the Amblers do accept donations (suggested donation: $4.00).
Meet to register inside the Baker Visitor Center at 08:30 a.m. Restrooms are available at the start point. Step-off is at 9:00 a.m.
The walk includes both a guided 5 KM and guided 10 KM option. Both walks have some moderate hills and stair climbing. A significant part of the route is on well-groomed trails with very few obstacles. There are some hills and natural surface paths. Some people will want walking poles.
Walks are through picturesque formal gardens, the Bonsai Exhibition, shaded scenic trails, and paths along a swift flowing stream. The trees should be just starting to color for fall.
After the walk, enjoy the annual plant show and sale.

Free and open to all ages (unless noted otherwise), it’s the perfect excuse to gather your crew, listen and vibe to a wide range of genres including soul, bluegrass, acoustic, country, folk and more. item.title: Outdoor Sport Climbing Trip! — Sun Sep 27, 8:00 AM — Bryson Gym
item.description:
Adventure Programs will be hosting an outdoor climbing trip to The Dump September 27th (Sunday) Located in Blowing Rock, NC! This area offers some of the best concentration of sport routes in NC high country.
If you've been interested in climbing and haven't had the chance to try it out, come along! If you love to mountaineer, explore nature, nurture your body, and spirit with natural movement, and climb cool rocks, come vibe with us!
No chalk? No climbing shoes? No harness? No worries!
All gear will be provided! If you have gear of your own, please feel free to bring anything that would feel comfortable for you :)
Bring lots of water, as well as a jacket for in the morning since it will be a little bit cooler. We will meet at Bryson gym at 8am, grab some breakfast @glad and then head out shortly after that. We'll all leave with time to get back to campus and have dinner!
Source: Warren Wilson College

item.title: How to Overcome Anger — Sun Sep 27, 10:30 AM
item.description:
Meditation in Asheville: Meditation and Modern Buddhism How to Overcome Anger with Modern Buddhism Teacher Kadam Sharon Lovich
Anger appears in many forms and disguises. Sometimes it manifests as a feeling of stress, other times it may take the form of depression. From the slightest frustration to resentment and embittered rage, anger is an emotion we all need to understand and conquer if we are to enjoy and make the most out of our life. In this series we will explore practical solutions to the problem of anger, deconstructing its actual causes and learning viable alternatives to this painful habit of mind. Cost: $12 (free and online options for members) [Read More and Register](https://www.meditationinasheville.org/sunday-drop-in-meditation-class/) [Become a Member](https://www.meditationinasheville.org/become-a-member/)

item.title: HOLLER & CROW — Sat Oct 10, 8:30 PM
item.description:
Holler & Crow specializes in whimsical folk fusion magic: music that makes listeners of all ages feel both transported and right at home. Audiences are treated to familiar and cherished traditional folk songs, humorous banter and delightful historical insights at every performance.
Whether it’s an intimate duo performance, a captivating trio, or a powerful 4-piece ensemble, Holler & Crow consists of skilled musicians and vocalists wielding powerful harmonies and folk instruments including viola/big fiddle, accordion, banjo, Irish bouzouki, guitar, and adding a touch of rhythmic flair with hand percussion.
Bring your dancing hobbit feet over and have a pint with us! Music 8:30-11:30pm $10 cover at the door.

item.title: Shut Up & Write - South Asheville — Sun Oct 11, 10:00 AM
item.description:
Shut Up & Write!® Western North Carolina Coworking for writers in your area! Join us for some focused writing time. All writers and all experience levels are welcome and don’t worry, no one will see what you've written. This session is about getting your writing done and meeting other writers in your area.
Please arrive a few minutes early to say hello to everyone, grab a drink, and get your writing tools ready. Once everyone’s arrived, I will lead quick introductions and then set the timer for our quiet and focused writing session.
Afterward, we’ll have time to chat and get to know each other. We often talk about our successes and challenges as writers. If you don’t have time to stick around, no worries!
A note about the format We don’t host critiques or readings. These events are a safe space for writers of all skill levels and genres to work on their craft, so no one will read or critique your writing.
For our full event schedule, visit https://shutupwrite.com

item.title: How to Overcome Anger — Sun Oct 11, 10:30 AM
item.description:
Meditation in Asheville: Meditation and Modern Buddhism How to Overcome Anger with Modern Buddhism Teacher Kadam Sharon Lovich
Anger appears in many forms and disguises. Sometimes it manifests as a feeling of stress, other times it may take the form of depression. From the slightest frustration to resentment and embittered rage, anger is an emotion we all need to understand and conquer if we are to enjoy and make the most out of our life. In this series we will explore practical solutions to the problem of anger, deconstructing its actual causes and learning viable alternatives to this painful habit of mind.
